litematica_container_filler.config.comme: Enable or disable the core features of the container filler mod.
When enabled, the mod will automatically and continuously search for under-stocked containers and fill them in the background.

False: Only fill the container you are looking at.
True: Automatically scan and fill all containers within the specified radius.
Scan radius for Area Fill Mode (1 - 32 blocks).
Highlight wireframe render radius for schematic containers (1 - 64 blocks).
When enabled, highlight borders and fill actions will only apply to containers within the current Litematica render layer.
When enabled, automatically hides the highlight border for containers that perfectly match the schematic requirements.
Receive Servux packets or hijack MiniHUD's cache to inspect container data without opening them.
Highlight schematic containers with missing, mismatched, or unsynchronized data using a wireframe.
When enabled, highlight borders will be visible through blocks and terrain (X-Ray).
Delay between auto-fill actions (in Ticks). Higher values mean slower operation.
Allows the mod to automatically open shulker boxes in your inventory to extract required materials when short.
When enabled, if the inventory is full, the mod will automatically stash unrelated junk into shulker boxes to free up space.
When enabled, if you have server OP permissions, the mod will actively request unopened container data from the server.
Highlight color for completely empty containers that require items. Use hex ARGB format.
Highlight color for containers with insufficient items or items in wrong slots. Use hex ARGB format.
Highlight color for containers with correct items but over-stacked, or containing extra junk. Use hex ARGB format.
Highlight color for containers holding completely wrong item types. Use hex ARGB format.
Highlight color for perfectly filled containers matching the schematic. Use hex ARGB format.
Highlight color for containers with unknown data (waiting for server sync). Use hex ARGB format.
litematica_container_filler.hotkey.comme: Press to immediately execute a single fill action.
Quickly switch between 'Single Crosshair Mode' and 'Area Scan Mode'.
Hotkey to open this mod's configuration menu (Default L + C).
